text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the park, I spotted
Karen Chan feeding the ducks at the pond.

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
There, there. Good job eating so much♪
I'll be sure to post all of your cute photos
on Umastagram, okay!

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? Who's that over there...?

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
Brian-san, ♪
Would you like to feed the duckies together with me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Feed them...? Not interested.
I was just passing by.

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, but somehow
you looked like you were totally free...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Mind your own business...

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
Still, it'll definitely be fun once you try it, you know?
I even got permission from the park manager
for the whole day today♪

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
So Brian-san, won't you join Karen
and try it together... pretty please?♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Tch, you're throwing off my pace.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Here, eat. It's food.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey. These guys aren't coming anywhere near
my food at all.

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you can't make such a scary face!
You're scaring the poor duckies away.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch, why should I be the one walking on eggshells?
I'm the one giving them food.

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
But the duckies think you're a bully, you know?
You have to let them know properly that you're their friend.

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, enjoy Karen's yummy food~♪
Sparkle sparkle~♪

text_block_list.name: Duck
text_block_list.text: Quack~ Quack~!

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
See, just like that♪
Brian-san, let's do it together♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: As if I could do that!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right then, perhaps frightened by Narita Brian's sudden fury,
the ducks in the pond all took flight at once—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: DON'T MOVE!!

text_block_list.name: Duck
text_block_list.text: (*Jolts in terror!*)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You brazen ducks... After ignoring me,
you've got some nerve trying to bolt without eating.

text_block_list.name: Duck
text_block_list.text: Q-Quack...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Get back here and line up single file... Good.
Now take your turns receiving it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Get back here and line up single file... Good.
Now take your turns receiving it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, child's play.
I should have just done this from the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, amazing~!
The little duckies are lining up so politely♪

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty♪
I'm gonna upload this to Umastagram too♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, in a manner truly characteristic of her,
Narita Brian successfully finished handing
out the duck feed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... To think you wouldn't eat
unless I laid it all out for you like this.

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? But wait, aren't the duckies
acting kinda strange?

text_block_list.name: Duck
text_block_list.text: Q-Quaaack...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The ducks were bringing the feed to their mouths...
However, likely paralyzed by terror, they literally
seemed unable to swallow it down...

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
Brian-san!
Dial down your aura, tone it down!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
D-Damn it...!
What a high-maintenance bunch of pests...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Doing it like this was
the quickest way after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, they ate it all.
Seriously, what troublesome little—

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text: —Huh?! Brian-san, behind you, behind you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —What?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Turning around... the ducks that had just been
subjugated were now marching solemnly behind
Narita Brian like loyal servants.

text_block_list.name: Duck
text_block_list.text: Quack!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Go home already!!
